item.title: Ending the Nightly Homework Battle
item.description: Danielle and Alex show parents how to end the nightly homework battle with a simple routine: anchor the start time to an event, build in a short reset, make a two-minute plan (quick win first, hardest task second), be nearby without hovering, and close with a packed bag by the door. The New To Education Podcast — education has no borders. Free Tutor-Choice Checklist: https://manage.kmail-lists.com/subscriptions/subscribe?a=VSg5wR&g=RSXDQh — more at https://newtoeducation.com
